newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil firmer, German buying supports barges.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil firmer, German buying supports barges.

text.p: NWE spot gas oil prices were firmer on Tuesday in line with gains on benchmark gas oil futures.
Traders reported good buying interest from German wholesalers on the ARA barge market, though inland refiners reported little demand from end-users.

Prompt lifting barges were traded at July IPE +25 cents several times with at least one block of around 10,000 tonnes destined for Germany. Traders said the buying interest was helping to counter fairly sloppy supplies in ARA and underpinning barge premiums.
Demand for diesel barges was not so strong though with several refiners report selling prompt barrels at around July IPE +$5.50-$6 a tonne but seeing very little buying interest.

Good Russian avails pegged back 0.2 sulphur cargo premiums cargo premiums to value around IPE July screen flat for prompt delivery 25kt parcels. 10kt stems were on offer around July IPE +$1 cif Hamburg and fob cargoes talked around MOM -$7.50/-$8.

Prompt delivery diesel cargoes talked July IPE +$5/+$6 a tonne cif NWE while early July cargoes valued around July IPE +$6 a tonne cif NWE. Quality Algerian material was also reported available at around July IPE +$7.00/+$7.50 a tonne cif NWE.
